deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to Settings > Checkout.
Click on 'Customize checkout' and select the 'Additional information' section.
Click on the '+ Add section' button and choose 'Form' from the dropdown menu.
Enter a title for your returns reason capture form, e.g., 'Reason for Return'.
In the 'Form fields' section, click on the '+ Add field' button and select 'Text field' as the field type.
Configure the text field to capture the customer's return reason by setting its label to 'Return Reason' and making it a required field.
Click on the 'Save' button to save your changes to the checkout settings.

To embed the returns reason capture form in your Shopify returns flow, you'll need to use Shopify's API or a third-party app that supports custom forms. Contact your developer or a Shopify expert for assistance with this step.
